title: Provenance / Source Current J_P Protocol
precondition: V1689.2 defines D_Gamma R_Gamma on an admissible comparison boundary. J_P must be emitted over that same boundary and independently from curvature.
core_rule: J_P is not a fitted residual. It is a ledger-derived current measuring provenance/source/pruning-order flux across the same retained comparison boundary used by D_Gamma R_Gamma.

identity_context.source_balanced_priority: source-balanced closure is primary; source-free closure is a special case

boundary_definition.comparison_boundary: B_ij is the retained boundary separating loop/cell i from loop/cell j, with base comparison Comp_{j->i}.
boundary_definition.same_boundary_rule: J_P,ij must be computed over exactly the same adjacency/boundary as (D_Gamma R_Gamma)_{ij}.
boundary_definition.orientation: J_P,ij is signed with respect to the ordered comparison direction j -> i or i -> j as declared in comparisons.csv.
boundary_definition.forbidden: Do not compute J_P on a different region than the curvature comparison boundary.

J_source.meaning: net source magnitude entering/leaving the retained comparison boundary

J_dependency.meaning: net provenance-dependency flux across the boundary

J_repair.meaning: net repair/closure current coupled to provenance restoration

J_order.meaning: retained-order flux and admissible pruning-order direction

J_label.formula: J_label,ij = signed_sum(provenance_relabel with conserved lineage) - lineage_breaks

aggregate_current.formula: J_P,ij = J_source + J_dependency + J_repair + J_order + J_label
aggregate_current.type: endomorphism-valued or algebra-state-valued current re-expressed in End_alg(G_i) using the same comparison basis as D_Gamma R_Gamma
aggregate_current.normalization: Each component must be reported separately and normalized by local boundary ledger scale.
aggregate_current.no_hiding_rule: A small aggregate J_P cannot hide a failed component current or order-arrow violation.

representation.primary_object: J_P,ij must be represented in the same algebraic comparison space as D_Gamma R_Gamma.
representation.projection_rule: If D_Gamma R_Gamma is endomorphism-valued, J_P must be lifted/represented as a source-current endomorphism or compatible algebra-state current through a declared current-to-endomorphism representation map.
representation.rho_requirement: rho_P must use ledger event structure only, not curvature residuals.

admissibility.J_boundary_pass: all events used in J_P share boundary_id with comparison_id
admissibility.J_order_pass: valid_order_arrow true for all contributing events or violations explicitly counted
admissibility.J_conservation_pass: source/provenance event accounting balances internally before comparison to curvature

killer_null_update.N_source_shuffle: preserve event counts and magnitudes but shuffle boundary assignments
killer_null_update.N_order_reverse: preserve events but reverse ordered_index dependencies
killer_null_update.N_label_shuffle: preserve labels counts but break lineage continuity
killer_null_update.expected: valid J_P balances D_Gamma R_Gamma; null currents fail E_Gamma or fail J_admissibility

frozen_nonclaims: J_P is not a target fitted after seeing curvature.
J_P cannot be computed from E_Gamma.
source-free closure cannot be tested before source-balanced closure.
